integrity: Theorem proved over C by explicit invariant ring, local quotient, crepant resolution, divisor pullback, and intersection arguments. Supporting symbolic computation checks polynomial and lattice identities, not global geometry.
scientific_limitations: The constructed rank-six star sublattice is not asserted to exhaust the Neron-Severi group; the base-point-free primitive degree-ten polarization contracts the A1 exceptional curve. Literature comparison cannot eliminate all earlier equivalent special weighted-K3 models.
title: A degree-ten K3 quotient and a five-armed curve star on the Fermat quintic surface
